# saluca-labs/.github

> Org-level files for Saluca Labs: the org profile README, the shared artwork, and the generator that produced it. No product code lives here.

This repository only serves the public face of the `saluca-labs` GitHub organization. If you are
looking for runnable research, start at https://github.com/saluca-labs and read a repo's own
`llms.txt`.

## Docs

- [profile/README.md](profile/README.md): the file GitHub renders on the org page. One paragraph
  of what Saluca Labs is, then every public repo grouped as Start here / Research and reproduction
  / Security and detection / Systems / For agents.
- [README.md](README.md): what this repo contains, how to hotlink a per-repo header, and how to
  regenerate the art.
- [tools/README.md](tools/README.md): generator inputs, dependencies and outputs.

## Code

- [tools/cardgen.py](tools/cardgen.py): the generator. HTML/CSS rendered by Playwright at exact
  pixel size. Reads a repo list as JSON, writes `social/<repo>.png` (1280 x 640) and
  `readme/<repo>.png` (1200 x 300). Raises on a repo with no portrait mapping or no blurb.
- [tools/org_repos.json](tools/org_repos.json): the `gh repo list --json` output the current art
  was generated from. Pinned so a rerun reproduces the same cards.

## Assets

- `assets/banner.png`: org profile header, 1280 x 400.
- `assets/social-preview.png`: org social preview, 1280 x 640.
- `assets/readme/<repo>.jpg`: per-repo README header, 1200 x 300, 18 files.
- `assets/portraits/`: pr0fx, Tiresias and Asphodel portraits plus the Saluca shield.

## Optional

- Palette: void `#050713`, indigo `#0d0a24`, cyan `#22e8ff`, magenta `#ff3fe0`, violet `#8b5cf6`,
  chrome `#c9cdd1`.
- Social preview images are uploaded through repo Settings; GitHub exposes no API for that step.
